questions.question: A helmet will give you the most protection if it has all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: A helmet protects you best when it meets U.S. DOT standards, fits snugly all the way around, and has no defects like cracks, loose padding, or frayed straps.

questions.question: Passengers should:

options.text: Look over their shoulder when the rider takes a turn or curve.
Sit as far back as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over their shoulder when the rider takes a turn or curve.
questions.explanation: Before riding, ask your passenger to look over your shoulder in the direction of any turn or curve. This helps you and the bike lean the right way.

questions.question: If your motorcycle starts to weave while riding over uneven metal bridge gratings, you should:

options.text: Downshift to a lower gear right away.
Ride in a zigzag pattern until you cross the bridge.

questions.explanation: If your motorcycle weaves over uneven bridge gratings, stay relaxed and ride straight across at a steady speed. Zigzagging is more dangerous than the weaving.

questions.question: Other drivers can see a motorcyclist most easily when riding in which lane position?
questions.explanation: The center lane position is usually best when following a car because it puts you in the driver's rearview mirror. Be ready to change positions if traffic or conditions change.

questions.question: When reacting to a hazard in the road, do not:

options.text: Avoid telling other drivers you are there.
Use your horn, lights, or signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid telling other drivers you are there.
questions.explanation: Tell other drivers you are there by using your horn, lights, and signals. Adjust your speed to fit the situation and change your lane position or direction as needed.

questions.question: Before you start riding, make sure the fuel valve is:
questions.explanation: Before riding, open your fuel valve. If it is closed, the engine may start with fuel left in the lines but will stall once those lines are empty.

questions.question: Using all three lane positions is:

options.text: Not a good idea because you won't get used to any part of the lane.
Not a good idea because it confuses other drivers.
A good idea if conditions are changing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A good idea if conditions are changing.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best. Change your position as road and traffic conditions require.

questions.question: When about to pass a vehicle on the left, ride in which part of the lane?
questions.explanation: When about to pass on the left, ride in the left part of your lane. This improves your view and helps drivers in the next lane see your move coming.

questions.question: Before starting a turn, a motorcyclist should change gears to:

options.text: Avoid a sudden power change in the middle of the turn.
Keep both hands on the handlebars during the turn.
Keep the motorcycle from slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid a sudden power change in the middle of the turn.
questions.explanation: Change gears before turning. Shifting while turning can cause a sudden power change that makes the rear wheel skid. If you must shift during a turn, do it smoothly to prevent skidding.

questions.question: A motorcycle's horn is ________ a car's horn.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's horn is not as loud as a car's horn. Use your horn when needed, but do not rely on it to keep you safe.

questions.question: When riding in a group through a curve, what formation should you use?
questions.explanation: Groups normally ride in a staggered formation. Switch to single file when taking a curve, making a turn, entering a highway, or leaving a highway.

questions.question: Where should you position your motorcycle when entering a curve?

options.text: Wherever traffic and road conditions require

questions.correctAnswerText: Wherever traffic and road conditions require
questions.explanation: Every curve is different. Choose a lane position that fits the conditions and adjust as needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a factor that affects blood alcohol content (BAC)?

options.text: How quickly the alcohol is consumed
How often the person consumes alcohol

questions.correctAnswerText: How often the person consumes alcohol
questions.explanation: BAC is determined by body weight, how much alcohol is consumed, and how quickly it is consumed. It is always safest to not ride after drinking any amount of alcohol.

questions.question: Under normal conditions, what is the minimum following distance?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds between you and the vehicle ahead under normal conditions. Increase this distance if conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that the road ahead is likely to be slippery when wet.

questions.question: When another vehicle passes you from behind, which part of the lane should you ride in?
questions.explanation: Ride in the center of the lane when being passed. This is the safest position. Riding on the side nearest the passing vehicle risks a collision. Riding on the far side may cause the driver to return to your lane too soon.

questions.question: When is it most important to flash your brake light?

options.text: When someone is following you too closely
When you will slow down suddenly
When there is a stop sign ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: When you will slow down suddenly
questions.explanation: Motorcycle brake lights are not as noticeable as car brake lights. Flash your brake light when slowing or stopping so others notice you are slowing down. This is especially important if you slow faster than expected.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show specific traffic laws for that area. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does an integrated braking system do?

options.text: It connects the front and rear brakes when the rear brake is applied
It automatically applies the brakes based on your riding habits
It is connected to the gears and applies the brake when downshifting

questions.correctAnswerText: It connects the front and rear brakes when the rear brake is applied
questions.explanation: Some motorcycles have integrated braking systems that connect the front and rear brakes when you apply the rear brake pedal. Check your owner's manual for details about your motorcycle's braking system.

questions.question: When someone passes you on the left, what should you do?

options.text: Ride on the right side of your lane.
Ride in the middle of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride in the middle of your lane.
questions.explanation: When being passed on your left, stay in the middle of your lane. Riding on the right side is dangerous because it may cause the other driver to move back into your lane too soon.

questions.question: _________ of collisions between motorcycles and cars are caused by drivers failing to give the right-of-way to the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: More than half of collisions between motorcycles and cars happen because drivers fail to give the right-of-way to motorcycles. Never assume that drivers will give you the right-of-way, even if the law requires them to do so.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: You can go over the speed limit until your pass is complete.
You can ignore no passing zone markings if you started the pass in a passing zone.
You must follow the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must follow the posted speed limit.
questions.explanation: All passes must be done at or below the posted speed limit. You can only pass in areas where passing is allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
Stop only if there is other traffic.
Vehicles will enter the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red traffic light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let all crossing traffic and pedestrians pass, and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When your passenger is on your motorcycle, tell them to:

options.text: Get on before you start the engine.
Sit as far back as possible.

questions.explanation: Tell passengers not to talk or move while the motorcycle is moving. Passengers should get on only after the engine is started. They should sit as far forward as possible without bothering the rider.
